name: Multiplayer Cursors
description: Named, colored cursors that move like teammates: hover, visually press, drag, select and type. Bring an interface to life without activating real clicks, links or forms.

controls.name: demo
controls.label: Demo
controls.description: Together runs three teammates at once. Click, Drag and Select show one interaction each.

controls.name: labelAnimation
controls.label: Label animation
controls.description: How the name label enters and changes when a cursor speaks. Wheel roll turns each letter on a drum; Masked Lift raises the text through a mask. Both use power4.out.

controls.name: speed
controls.label: Speed
controls.description: Time scale for movement, pauses and typing. 2 plays the scripts twice as fast.

controls.name: clickEffect
controls.label: Click effect
controls.description: Press the arrow and pulse a ring in the cursor color on every simulated press. Preview state can respond through onCursorPress; no native click is dispatched.

controls.name: idleDrift
controls.label: Idle drift (px)
controls.description: Gentle sway while a cursor rests, like a hand on a mouse. It fades out during moves, drags and selections.

controls.name: labelLag
controls.label: Label trail
controls.description: How far the name label trails behind the arrow on a critically damped spring. 0 keeps it rigid; 1 lets it swing behind fast moves.

controls.name: cursorSize
controls.label: Cursor size
controls.description: Scale of the arrow and label.

controls.name: loop
controls.label: Loop
controls.description: Replay the scripts after every cursor finishes. Selections clear and onCycle resets the demo.

controls.name: easing
controls.label: Easing
controls.description: Velocity profile along each path. Human uses the minimum-jerk profile of real hand reaches: a smooth start, a fast middle and a gentle landing.

controls.name: curvature
controls.label: Curvature
controls.description: Sideways bend of each path, like a wrist rotating. 0 moves in straight lines, 1 is natural and 2 or more draws wide arcs.

controls.name: overshoot
controls.label: Overshoot
controls.description: Moves longer than 160 px pass the target slightly, then correct onto it, as hands do. 0 lands directly.

controls.name: reachTime
controls.label: Reach time (ms)
controls.description: Fixed time of every move (the Fitts's law intercept). Higher values make every move slower.

controls.name: reachScale
controls.label: Distance slowdown (ms)
controls.description: Extra time per bit of difficulty, log2(1 + distance / target size) (the Fitts's law slope). Far or small targets take longer. 0 makes every move take the same time.

controls.name: maxReach
controls.label: Longest move (ms)
controls.description: Upper limit for one move, before the Speed time scale.

controls.name: landingSpread
controls.label: Landing spread
controls.description: How far from the target center the cursor lands, varying each time like a person. 0 always hits the exact center.

controls.name: dragPace
controls.label: Drag pace
controls.description: How many times slower drags and box selections move than free moves. Holding a button makes hands slower and more careful.

controls.name: trail
controls.label: Cursor trail (ms)
controls.description: Length of a fading trail behind each arrow, in its color, measured in time. 0 draws no trail. The trail shrinks away while the cursor rests.

controls.name: trailWidth
controls.label: Trail width (px)
controls.description: Stroke width at the newest end of the trail; older parts taper and fade.
